codeReview.summary: Implementation covers all feature requirements: connection pool (25 max connections), transaction support, JSONB query helpers, pagination logic, and CRUD operations for evaluations, results, and predictions. All 23 tests pass with 79.4% coverage. Foreign key enforcement verified. Error handling is robust throughout.

issues.description: Result struct is defined in repository file rather than model package, inconsistent with Evaluation which is in model package. Creates potential confusion when importing types.
Prediction struct is defined in repository file rather than model package, inconsistent with Evaluation which is in model package.
UpdateStatus method relies on database triggers (started_at, completed_at) from database-schema feature. This dependency should be documented for future workers.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker defined Result and Prediction structs in their repository files rather than in the model package. Evaluation is defined in model package, creating inconsistency. AGENTS.md shows Repository Pattern but doesn specify where domain entities should live.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: internal/repository/result_repository.go:17-27 defines Result struct; internal/repository/prediction_repository.go:15-28 defines Prediction struct; internal/model/evaluation.go defines Evaluation struct

sharedStateObservations.observation: The UpdateStatus method relies on database triggers for timestamp management (started_at when status=running, completed_at when status=completed/failed). This cross-feature dependency on database-schema triggers is not documented in library.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: evaluation_repository.go:188 comment states 'database trigger will automatically set started_at and completed_at'. Handoff verification confirms triggers work (started_at set when status changes to running)

summary: PASS. Repository layer implementation fully satisfies all requirements with comprehensive tests. Connection pool configured with 25 max connections via pgxpool. Transaction support via BeginTx. JSONB query helpers work correctly (QueryByMetrics uses metrics->>key operator). Pagination uses LIMIT/OFFSET ordered by created_at DESC. Foreign key enforcement rejects invalid IDs. Minor observations: domain structs placement inconsistency and undocumented trigger dependency.
